# Set Up

## Load Libraries

```{r library}
suppressMessages({                                                              # Suppress startup messages for cleaner logs
  library(dplyr)                                                                # For data manipulation
  library(irlba)                                                                # For efficient truncated SVD/PCA
  library(SummarizedExperiment)                                                 # For handling SummarizedExperiment objects
  library(parallel)                                                             # For parallel processing backend
  library(doParallel)                                                           # For parallel processing with foreach
})                                                                              # End suppressMessages

base_dir <- "../../.."                                                          # Define project base directory relative to script location
analysis_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "DATASET", "_HARMONIZATION")                # Define harmonization analysis directory
code_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "R")                                        # Define directory containing helper R scripts
data_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data_CN_only/preprocessing/FHS")           # Define directory for processed Framingham data
submit_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "data_CN_only/submission/FHS")            # Define directory for final Framingham data

source(file.path(code_dir, "run_pca.R"), local = TRUE)                          # source PCA functions
```

# Load Data

```{r load}
dnam_data <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "DNAm_batched.RDS"))                   # Read batch-corrected DNA methylation data
```

# Run PCA

```{r pca}
pca_res <- process_dataset(                                                     # Run PCA workflow with outlier detection
  dnam_data,                                                                    # Input SummarizedExperiment object
  outlier_cutoff = 3,                                                           # Z-score threshold (3 SD from mean)
  pc_count = 5,                                                                 # Calculate 5 principal components
  pc_label = "PC_",                                                             # Prefix for PC column names
  outlier_label = "is_outlier",                                                 # Column name for outlier flag
  filter_outlier = FALSE                                                        # Keep all samples (don't remove outliers)
)                                                                               # Returns list with PCA results
dnam_data <- pca_res$dnam_data                                                  # Extract updated SummarizedExperiment
pca_df <- pca_res$pca_df                                                        # Extract data frame with PC scores
percentVar <- pca_res$percentVar                                                # Extract variance explained by each PC
pca_params <- pca_res$pca_params                                                # Extract PC summary statistics
```

# Plot

```{r plot}
message(                                                                        # Print outlier summary message
  "In ",                                                                        # Dataset identifier prefix
  "FHS",                                                                        # Dataset name
  " there are a total of ",                                                     # Message text
  sum(pca_df$is_outlier),                                                       # Count outlier samples
  " outliers out of ",                                                          # Message text
  nrow(pca_df),                                                                 # Total number of samples
  " samples"                                                                    # Message suffix
)                                                                               # End message

for (plot_var in plot_vars) {                                                   # Loop through plotting variables
  pca_df[,plot_var] <- as.character(pca_df[,plot_var])                          # Convert plot variable to character
  p <- plot_pca(                                                                # Create PCA scatter plot
    pca_df,                                                                     # Data frame with PC scores and metadata
    dataset = "FHS",                                                            # Dataset name for plot title
    plot_var = c("age_split_by_tertiles", "Sex"),                               # Variables for coloring points
    percentVar = percentVar,                                                    # Variance explained (for axis labels)
    pca_params = pca_params,                                                    # PC statistics (for outlier boundaries)
    outlier_cutoff = 3,                                                         # Z-score threshold for boundaries
    pc_label = "PC_",                                                           # Prefix for PC column names
    outlier_label = "is_outlier"                                                # Column name for outlier flag
  )                                                                             # Returns ggplot2 object
  
  print(p)                                                                      # Display plot
}                                                                               # End for loop
```

# Save

```{r save}
saveRDS(dnam_data, file = file.path(data_dir, "DNAm_pca.RDS"))                  # Save final beta-value DNAm object

exp_data <- SummarizedExperiment::assays(dnam_data)$dnam %>%                    # Extract beta value matrix
  as.data.frame() %>%                                                           # Convert to data frame
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "CpG")                                       # Add CpG IDs as first column

write.table(                                                                    # Write harmonized data to file
  x = exp_data,                                                                 # Data frame to write
  file = file.path(submit_dir, paste0(dataset, "_harmonized.tsv")),             # Output file path
  quote = FALSE,                                                                # Don't quote strings
  sep = "\t",                                                                   # Tab-separated format
  row.names = FALSE,                                                            # Don't write row names
  col.names = TRUE                                                              # Write column names
)                                                                               # End write.table
```
